verdict.rationale: Streaming quality is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack (CLI, REST API, portal docs) never documents adaptive quality under poor connections or user-adjustable resolution and frame rate. The community items only debate a launch framerate benchmark and the lack of bandwidth/codec visibility, which shows no such controls.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
